slides.title: "Fine" isn't a *feeling*.
slides.sub: What's actually there when you say it?

slides.title: Catch the word
slides.body: Notice how often "fine" comes out today. With a friend, at work, in your own head. Just count it.

slides.title: Look underneath
slides.body: Each time, ask: what's actually here? Tired. Worried. Hurt. Relieved. Pick the closest word, even just to yourself.

slides.title: Say one out loud
slides.body: You don't have to tell everyone. Try the truer word once this week, with someone you trust.

slides.title: Then notice
slides.body: What changed when the feeling had a name? What was "fine" letting you skip?
